name: react-stages
description: Stages, super flexible wizard and form components for React
author: Fredi Bach

scripts.build:v1: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/dom/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/vue/tsconfig.build.json && ngc -p packages/angular/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/test-kit/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:examples:v1: npm --prefix examples/vanilla run build && npm --prefix examples/react run build && npm --prefix examples/vue run build && npm --prefix examples/angular run build
scripts.check:v1: npm run check:quality && npm run check:docs:v1 && npm run check:apps:v1 && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run build:v1 && npm run check:public-api:v1 && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.compiler-spike.json && npm run test:example-contract:v1 && tsc -p packages/dom/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vue/tsconfig.json --noEmit && ngc -p packages/angular/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/test-kit/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/vanilla/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/vue/tsconfig.json --noEmit && ngc -p examples/angular/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && npm run check:acceptance:v1 && npm run verify:packages:v1 && npm run performance:v1
scripts.check:apps:v1: node scripts/check-v1-apps.mjs && npm --prefix studio run check
scripts.check:quality: npm run check:knip && npm run check:e18e && npm run doctor
scripts.release:check:v1: npm run check:v1 && npm run test:v1 && npm --prefix studio run test:v1 && npm --prefix studio run build && npm --prefix docs run build && npm run build:examples:v1 && npm --prefix examples/react test && npm run test:examples:v1
scripts.test:v1: npm run build:v1 && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/dom/test/*.test.mjs packages/react/test/*.test.mjs packages/vue/test/*.test.mjs packages/angular/test/*.test.mjs packages/test-kit/test/*.test.mjs
